name: meridian
note: 虚构公司，刻意不用真实实体：模型读过的东西量出来的是记忆，不是这条流水线。句子写得钝——一句一个事实、日期写全、名字写全——因为这个台子要量的是时间那根轴，不是抽取的运气。

waves.label: wave-1
waves.note: 第一波灌完之后记一个时刻。记录轴上的所有题目都以它为界：那时我们还不知道后来的交接与更正。

documents.text:
# Project Aurora charter

Project Aurora started on 2023-01-10 at Meridian Systems.

Zhang San leads Project Aurora from 2023-01-10.

Project Aurora is part of the Platform Group.

The Platform Group is part of Meridian Systems.

# Offer record

Lin Zhao joined Meridian Systems on 2023-06-01.

Lin Zhao works for Meridian Systems from 2023-06-01.

Lin Zhao has the job title Staff Engineer from 2023-06-01.

Lin Zhao has a salary of 28000 CNY from 2023-06-01.

# Assistant note

Wang Wu advises Project Aurora from 2023-03-02.

Wang Wu works for Meridian Systems from 2020-09-01.

waves.label: wave-2
waves.note: 第二波在第一个时刻之后才灌：世界轴上它们讲的是 2024 年的事，记录轴上它们是「后来才知道的」。删除那一条制造撤回。

documents.text:
# Handover memo

Li Si leads Project Aurora from 2024-07-05.

Li Si works for Meridian Systems from 2021-04-01.

# Payroll correction

Lin Zhao has a salary of 32000 CNY from 2024-02-20.

The raise was approved by the Platform Group.

axioms_note: 时态引擎的自动闭合**只按本体的声明跑**：`functional` / `inverse_functional` 永不自动推断（理由见 bootstrap_ontology.rs——它驱动的是自动改写账本）。所以这两条声明是被测配置的一部分，跑分前先建出来；`--no-declare` 跑的是「本体自己长出来」的那种库，两组的差就是这条声明值多少。

classes.label: Organization
classes.description: A company or a group inside one.

classes.label: Project
classes.description: A named piece of work with people responsible for it.

axioms.label: leads
axioms.description: The person currently responsible for a project. One project has one lead at a time.

axioms.label: works for
axioms.description: The organization a person is employed by.

axioms.label: part of
axioms.description: A group or project inside a larger organization.

axioms.label: salary
axioms.description: The person's monthly salary. One value holds at a time.

axioms.label: job title
axioms.description: The person's job title. One title holds at a time.

axioms.label: advises
axioms.description: A person who advises a project without being responsible for it. Several advisers are possible.
